lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Héctor, this is Daniela. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not bad. Sleeping better.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: After treatment I had no energy at all. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I like what I eat. I'm not going to change at my age.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So it's not that you don't care. It's that remembering keeps getting in the way.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You think you can do it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the band exercises fit in your day?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, I can do the band while I watch my novela.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the band exercises. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I do the band exercises 5 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: Same scripted tip given verbatim four times (lines 8, 10, 18, 25) without tailoring to participant responses.
Warns 'your health is going to suffer' without permission, undermining autonomy after participant expressed ambivalence.
Pushes a reframe ('getting your life back') the participant did not invite, after participant noted family commitment.
Participant's confidence ('I know I can do it, I did it before') was reflected only briefly; could have been elicited further with an open question.

score.summary: Daniela elicited useful change talk around confidence, family commitment, and a concrete plan to exercise while watching her novela. However, she repeated the same scripted tip four times and used warnings and reframes the participant did not invite, which undercut partnership.
strengths: Line 31: affirmed persistence on a hard week, reinforcing self-efficacy.
Line 20: emphasized autonomy ('It's completely your call') after resistance at line 19.
Line 47: collaboratively set a specific, achievable goal of five sessions, grounded in the participant's own plan from line 41.
Line 48: set a clear follow-up contact (midweek text and call in two weeks).
coaching_tips: Lines 8, 10, 18, 25 repeat the same tip verbatim; ask permission and tailor the idea to Héctor's stated barriers instead.
Line 38: replace the health warning with a reflection, e.g., 'Staying active matters to you because of your grandkids.'
Line 42: drop the 'getting your life back' reframe; follow his lead instead, as he did at line 41.
Line 26: respond to 'I know I can do it' with an open question such as 'What helped you do it before?' to build on his confidence.
Line 15: after 'Not yet,' explore the gap with an open question before offering advice.
